disposition: fire attack, water supply and vertical ventilation; battalion chief command
summary: Crews arrived to a fully involved single-story, single-family dwelling. The first-arriving engine pulled an attack line, incoming companies secured a water supply and pulled a backup line, and a truck company worked on vertical ventilation and utilities. A battalion chief took command of the fire.

disposition: fire and medical response; CHP handling the investigation
summary: Fire companies and an ambulance were sent to a vehicle versus pedestrian collision on the Edison Highway block. The California Highway Patrol took over the investigation.

Officers were sent to a report of a fight between two brothers on the Allen Road block, one of them armed with a metal stick. A caller reported one person was down and that several people were involved.

Officers were sent to a just-occurred call on the McDonald Way block after a woman said her ex-husband broke a window to get inside and tried to stab her boyfriend with a glass bottle. The caller said he jumped a fence on the west side of the property, and units checked the area.
Deputies were sent to an in-progress burglary on the Park Drive block after a caller reported a man trying to break into the residence while a woman inside spoke with him.

Officers were sent to a call at the Hard Rock Casino that had occurred within the previous ten minutes, after a victim said a man came at them from behind. A person matching the description was reported to be with security near the main entrance.

Officers were sent to an in-progress domestic violence call on the Belle Terrace block. A caller described a woman in her 30s striking a man, and the two were reported leaving eastbound in a white car.

disposition: call disconnected; prior calls noted at the address
summary: A hang-up call from a cellphone was logged as a possible domestic violence call at an apartment on the Buckley Way block. Dispatchers noted previous calls to the same address, and the line went dead before further details were given.
A vehicle was reported stolen within the previous ten minutes from the Quincy Street block. The car, a gray 2020 Honda Civic, was last seen heading east.
Medics were sent to a motel on the Olive Tree Court block for an overdose call on an exterior staircase.
An engine company was sent to a commercial fire alarm at a Calloway Drive retail store.
Officers were sent to a disturbance between a resident and his son on the East Wind Circle block, with a caller reporting the younger man was under the influence.

disposition: two engines, a truck and a battalion chief sent
summary: Companies were sent to a fire reported across from the South Union Avenue block, with two engines, a truck and a battalion chief assigned.
Officers were sent to check on a woman on the Country Club Drive block after a caller reported she was not making sense.
Dispatchers passed along a report that traffic lights were out at Robertson Road.
Officers were sent to the 34th Street area for a report of a person in dark clothing intentionally jumping in front of vehicles.
Officers were sent to a Buena Vista Road pharmacy after a report of a man sleeping next to a propane tank outside the store.
A crew was sent to check a hazard reported at a Panama Lane location.
